title: Colimits of coherent directed iterated tensor cocones
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $i_0\le i$, and $B_0,C_0$ commutative $F(i_0)$-algebras. Put $B_j=F(j)\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$, $C_j=F(j)\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$, $B=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$, $C=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$ and $J=\{j\in I\mid i\le j\}$. Let $P,Q$ be commutative rings with $Q$ a $P$-algebra, and give $B,B_j$ $P$-algebra structures. Give ring diagrams $D,E:J\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ in a common universe, equivalences $d_j:D(j)\simeq B_j\otimes_PQ$, $c_j:E(j)\simeq C_j$, cocones $c_D,c_E$, equivalences $d_\infty:c_D.\mathrm{pt}\simeq B\otimes_PQ$, $c_\infty:c_E.\mathrm{pt}\simeq C$, and $P$-linear maps $\mu_j:B_j\to B$. Suppose $\mu_j$ is the canonical tensor coprojection and that $d_\infty c_D.\iota_j=(\mu_j\otimes\mathrm{id}_Q)d_j$, while $c_\infty c_E.\iota_j$ is the canonical $C_j\to C$ composed with $c_j$. Suppose for every $j\le k$ there is a $P$-linear canonical tensor transition $\beta_{kj}:B_j\to B_k$ such that $d_kD(j\le k)=(\beta_{kj}\otimes\mathrm{id}_Q)d_j$, and $c_kE(j\le k)$ is the canonical transition $C_j\to C_k$ composed with $c_j$. Then both $c_D$ and $c_E$ are colimit cocones. No comparison map between $D$ and $E$ is assumed.

source.place: Tags 00D6, 00D7 and 00DD (lemma-tensor-products-commute-with-limits), directed representatives, eventual equality, and tensor products commuting with colimits; direct proof of 00DD read online on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Apply the directed tensor elementwise theorem to B₀ and C₀. Restrict its representatives to J = {j | i ≤ j} by moving any representative to a common upper bound with i and using colimit.w, verified by tensor induction. Eventual vanishing from a stage of J remains in J.

Choose the P-linear canonical transitions β from hDt. Their underlying ring maps are canonical tensor transitions. Tensor induction, F.map_id and F.map_comp give the directed-system laws; hμs and colimit.w give compatibility of μs. Form the P-module direct limit of Bⱼ and its induced linear map g to B. Representatives from step 1 give surjectivity. Represent a difference a-b, use eventual vanishing from step 1, and DirectLimit.of_f to show its class zero, proving injectivity.

Tensor the linear equivalence induced by g with Q over P. Mathlib TensorProduct.directLimitLeft identifies the tensor of the module direct limit with the direct limit of Bⱼ tensor_P Q, and its pure-tensor formula identifies stage maps with μs tensor id. Module.DirectLimit.exists_of and Module.DirectLimit.of.zero_exact give representatives and eventual vanishing in the iterated tensors.

Transport the representatives and eventual vanishing of steps 1 and 3 along the stage and vertex ring equivalences, using hcE, hEt, hcD and hDt. For either ring cocone, Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' proves that its underlying type cocone is a colimit: representatives give surjectivity, and eventual vanishing of a-b gives eventual equality. Mathlib filtered ring colimits preserve the forgetful functor, which reflects isomorphisms, so isColimitOfReflects gives each ring colimit. The required size-v instances are obtained from the common universe by hasColimitsOfSizeOfUnivLE and preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_of_univLE.

theorem isColimit_directed_tensor_cocones
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (aPs : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (D E : {j : I // i ≤ j} ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y})
    (d : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPs j
      ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q)
    (c : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (cD : Cocone D) (cE : Cocone E)
    (dLim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      ↥cD.pt ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q)
    (cLim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      ↥cE.pt ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (μs : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
      letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPs j
      letI := aP
      (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
        (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (hμs : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
      letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
              (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
      (μs j).toRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom)
    (hcD : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
      letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPs j
      letI := aP
      dLim.toRingHom.comp (cD.ι.app j).hom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (μs j) (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
          (d j).toRingHom)
    (hDt : ∀ {j k : {j : I // i ≤ j}} (r : j ⟶ k),
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPs j
      letI := aPs k
      ∃ β : (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
          (↥(F.obj k.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀),
        (let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
          { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
            commutes' := fun s ↦
              congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                  (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm };
          β.toRingHom =
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk
              (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
        (d k).toRingHom.comp (D.map r).hom =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map β (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
            (d j).toRingHom)
    (hcE : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
      letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
              (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
      cLim.toRingHom.comp (cE.ι.app j).hom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
          (c j).toRingHom)
    (hEt : ∀ {j k : {j : I // i ≤ j}} (r : j ⟶ k),
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
      let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
          { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
            commutes' := fun s ↦
              congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                  (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm }
      (c k).toRingHom.comp (E.map r).hom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
          (c j).toRingHom)
    : Nonempty (IsColimit cD) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit cE)
